completed_from_existing_local_files.dataset: CORA.RDR Si IGBT accelerated power cycling
completed_from_existing_local_files.lots_definition: one continuously aged physical device per file
completed_from_existing_local_files.protocol: On-state Vce is averaged per eight-second cycle after rejecting off-state and artifact samples. The first 15, 25 or 50 percent of each device trajectory predicts the median final one percent. Ratio priors use the other two devices only.
completed_from_existing_local_files.caveat: Accelerated power cycling to failure, not component burn-in. DUT2 was preconditioned by cutting one of six bond wires. Three devices are too few for a production performance claim.

completed_from_existing_local_files.source: Kaggle Bosch Production Line Performance competition
completed_from_existing_local_files.licence: Competition data. Use and redistribution are subject to the Kaggle competition rules.
completed_from_existing_local_files.lots_definition: ten unit production time window crossed with exact station path
completed_from_existing_local_files.model: HistGradientBoosting on row statistics and 48 measurements selected using training data only
completed_from_existing_local_files.caveat: Real rare production failures, but not burn-in trajectories. Labels identify line failures and do not identify semiconductor failure mechanisms. The competition data cannot be redistributed.

cora_identifier_check.archive_name_mismatch: The earlier archive name contained data3204; the dataset's own Readme states data3206.

gEOL.protocol: Leave one device out. First 15 percent of cycle trajectory predicts median final one percent VCE,sat.
gEOL.caveat: Power cycling degradation, not burn-in. Same early-to-late forecasting structure.
